description: Spacious retreat on 4 lush acres with stunning ocean views and powered by the bright Caribbean sun! Ideal for large or multi-family stays, this 5BR home includes 2 kitchens, a private pool, hammocks, Wi-Fi, outdoor Traeger grill, indoor and outdoor dining area. Just 7 mins to the beach, pet-friendly, and freshly remodeled. Rent the full property (incl. 1BR apartment). Peaceful, private, and perfect for your island escape.The spaceCome relax and unwind at Villa de Sueños- The Villa of Dreams! This spacious, modern home has 4 bedrooms and 3 1/2 baths on the main floor plus a bonus office suite. There is also a fully equipped, self catering one bedroom apartment with a private entrance for a total of 5 bedrooms 4 1/2 baths. In the main house, the King master suite is connected to the office with its own entrance and a walled garden area for extra privacy. Next to the office off the balcony is a half bath. Bedrooms 2 & 3 are set up as a “Jack & Jill” suite. Each bedroom is private with a bathroom between and a double door that closes the whole space. Bedroom 2 has a King bed and Bedroom 3 has a Queen. Finally the 4th bedroom has 1 double bed and 1 twin bed and a second twin that can be set up on request. This room has semi private access to a full bathroom. The kitchen boasts an extra large island with plenty of space for a private chef to cater fabulous meals on the beautiful balcony while you watch sunsets enjoying gentle Caribbean breezes. Enjoy grilling fresh caught local fish on the Traeger pellet grill. Loads of space for families and friends to gather and reconnect after sun drenched days of beach combing, surfing and snorkeling. The 5th bedroom is actually a fully private apartment with its own kitchen, bath and balcony area just above the pool level that sleeps 4. In the bedroom there is 1 double bed and 1 Queen bed. There are lounge chairs and a ping pong table.Guest access-Guests have access to the entire home and pool area. -Guests are limited to the maintained areas of the outside grounds only.

title: The Mountain | Retreat in Rincón
description: Peaceful hillside suite in Rincón, surrounded by nature.Located about 10 minutes from the beach and downtown, this spacious 1BR, 1BA suite with sofa bed is ideal for guests who value calm and privacy. Features tranquil green decor inspired by the mountains. The property runs on solar energy and includes a shared 600-gallon water tank for added comfort during service interruptions. A relaxed stay in a quiet setting.The spaceWelcome to La Montaña – Your Hillside EscapeThis cozy and spacious unit features 1 private bedroom with a queen-size bed and an additional queen sofa bed in the living room, comfortably sleeping up to 4 guests. Enjoy a fully equipped kitchen, a full bathroom, free WiFi, and a smart TV for streaming. The open-concept dining and living area is styled with Boho Chic decor, inspired by the lush surroundings of Rincón and designed to invite calm, comfort, and connection with nature.Guest accessCheck-in is self-service through a secure lockbox located just outside the unit. You are welcome to check in any time after 3:00 PM, unless an early check-in has been previously arranged and approved. The lockbox code will be sent closer to your arrival time, and it changes after each guest to ensure security.Other things to noteBefore You Book – What to Know 🏞️El Danuview sits on a lush Rincón hillside, just 10 minutes from downtown and the beach! But to get this view, you’ll travel up scenic, curvy roads—some steep, narrow, and one-lane in parts. It’s part of the adventure, so we highly recommend having a car.Also, while the area is full of natural beauty and laid-back vibes, it can get lively—especially on weekends or during holidays. You might hear music, parties, or other celebrations. It’s part of the colorful, vibrant culture that makes Puerto Rico so alive. If you’re seeking silence 24/7, this might not be the perfect fit—but if you love energy, sunshine, and mountain views, you’ll feel right at home!Traveling with a Group? Discover Danuview Suites! ✨While you’re viewing this specific unit, don’t miss the opportunity to book multiple suites together ideal for family vacations, group getaways, retreats, or celebrations.Here are our tailored group options:• 8 guests in 2 units: La Montaña + Coral• 12 guests in 2 units: La Palma + La Ola• 16 guests in 3 units: La Palma + La Ola + La Montaña• 20 guests when booking all 4 suites: La Palma, La Ola, La Montaña, and CoralEach suite is fully equipped and thoughtfully designed—offering comfort, privacy, and easy access to pools, beach-style amenities, and shared spaces. You’ll enjoy staying close while still having the room to unwind.💬 Send us a message to check availability for your group—we’re happy to help create the perfect stay.Together is better at Danuview Suites.Attention to all our potential guests:- We have stocked the space with essential items, however, you will likely need to supplement with your own during your stay such as toilet paper, paper towels, soaps, etc

description: Private 3-bedroom Rincón home with a private pool, solar power, and peaceful hillside views where goats graze. Just minutes from world-class surfing, stunning beaches, and a vibrant downtown packed with cafés, bars, and local shops. Secluded and serene, yet close to everything that makes Rincón special. An optional attached studio apartment with a rooftop deck and breathtaking sunset water views is perfect for extra guests or added privacy. Ideal for families, couples, and small groups.The spaceEscape to this beautifully situated short-term rental in the heart of Rincón, offering the perfect balance of privacy, convenience, and authentic coastal charm. This inviting three-bedroom home sits on a quiet hillside surrounded by lush tropical greenery, giving guests a sense of secluded relaxation while still being just a quick three-minute drive from the beach and the vibrant downtown district. Rincón is beloved for its many beaches, relaxed surf culture, and some of the best wave conditions in Puerto Rico, making it a favorite destination for surfers, beachgoers, and sun-seekers from around the world. The home’s setting provides picturesque views of the rolling hillsides, where friendly goats graze throughout the day and add a uniquely warm touch to the landscape. Guests can begin their mornings poolside with coffee and end their days with a refreshing swim after a day of adventure. The private pool, comfortable interior spaces, and fully equipped kitchen make the main house well-suited for families, couples, and small groups seeking both flexibility and comfort.For travelers needing additional accommodations or more privacy within their group, the property also includes an attached studio apartment that can be rented along with the main home. This separate space features its own rooftop deck with partial water views, offering a serene setting for sunset gatherings, stargazing, or simply unwinding with the ocean breeze. The evening skies in Rincón are known for their colorful, dramatic sunsets, and the rooftop deck offers one of the best vantage points on the property to experience them. While the location feels tucked away from the world, it remains remarkably close to everything visitors love about Rincón. Within minutes, you can reach beautiful beaches ideal for sunbathing, swimming, paddleboarding, snorkeling, or catching the renowned local surf. The downtown area is equally accessible, offering an exciting mix of open-air cafés, restaurants, boutique shopping, weekly art and farmers markets, and lively bars with local music. From fresh seafood to craft cocktails to cozy coffee shops, the food and culture scene is an integral part of Rincón's appeal. Whether you’re here to chase waves, explore the coastline, relax by the pool, or simply settle into a slower pace of life, this home provides an ideal base for your stay. The combination of privacy, scenery, amenities, and proximity to town creates a rare and memorable experience for travelers seeking both comfort and character in their accommodations. With flexible space, thoughtful conveniences, and a setting that captures the essence of Rincón, this rental offers a truly enjoyable getaway for guests looking to make the most of Puerto Rico’s west coast.Guest accessGuests enjoy exclusive access to the main house. The pool is shared only with the studio apartment, and the rooftop deck is available for your use when the studio isn’t rented. Laundry facilities are shared and located in the carport. If you would like the entire property to yourselves, please inquire about reserving the studio apartment as well.Other things to noteParties and events are not allowed.No smoking is permitted inside the home.

title: Rincon Red Door Ocean View Apartment
description: Welcome to the Red Door Beach Ocean View ApartmentNestled along the iconic 413 Interior, our apartment offers a truly magical stay just steps from Rincon’s best surf spots and top local restaurants.Wake up to breathtaking ocean views and enjoy your morning coffee on the wraparound balcony—the perfect spot to soak in the serene beauty of the island. The ocean and Jungle ambiance add a unique charm to your stay.Come experience the Red Door—you’ll fall in love with everything it has to offer.The spaceThis two-bedroom, top-level apartment offers stunning ocean views and is the perfect place to unwind after a day of sun, surf, and island adventures.Step into a space designed for comfort and relaxation—whether you're lounging in the hammock swing on the lanai listening to the soothing sounds of coquí frogs, or cooking up a storm in the well-equipped, chef-friendly kitchen, you'll feel right at home.The location is unbeatable—just a short walk to popular surf breaks, local eateries, and beach bars on Rincón's vibrant west coast. On select weekends, the nearby local wedding venue brings a touch of excitement and live music to the neighborhood, while Sunday brunch pool parties are a fun way to experience the local scene.Tucked away like a hidden gem surrounded by lush greenery, this beach apartment feels both private and connected to nature—offering a truly memorable stay.Guest accessGuests will access the upstairs apartment through the small gate on the right side of the front fence (when facing the house). Follow the walkway into the driveway, then continue along the clearly marked signs across the front of the home. You'll find the staircase on the left side, which leads you up to the front door on the second-level lanai.You’ll have exclusive access to the entire top floor, including the wrap-around lanai, perfect for enjoying breathtaking ocean views with your morning coffee or evening glass of wine.To reach the beach, exit through the front gate, turn right on the road, and take the first right into the parking lot. You'll find the beach access directly from there.Other things to notePlease note that no pets or additional overnight guests beyond those included in your booking are allowed to stay at the Ocean View Apartment. This policy is in place out of respect for other guests and for the safety of the friendly, local animals that live on the property.House management resides in the lower-level unit and is available should you need any assistance during your stay.While we maintain a strict no-pets policy for guests, there is a resident cat on the property who occasionally visits the outdoor balcony. She is very friendly and will happily leave you alone if you prefer not to engage. Rest assured, no animals are permitted inside the upstairs unit, ensuring a clean and allergy-conscious environment.We are also equipped with a backup generator in case of a power outage. For safety reasons, guests are not permitted to operate the generator. If the power goes out, please notify us, and house management will take care of activating it as soon as possible. We kindly ask for your patience and understanding in these rare instances.

description: The Honeymoon Suite is a studio apartment surrounded by tropical gardens and waterfalls. The studio has a balcony with a small table, two chairs and a gorgeous ocean view - the perfect spot to have coffee with your partner before heading to the beach. We are located less than a five minute walk from the beach, restaurants and a lively nightlife. There are many restaurants in the area that are perfect for date night!The spacehe Honeymoon Suite is complete with a queen bed, kitchen, couch, TV, private balcony and a/c. This studio is on the second floor above our private bar which is closed unless a guest requests to open it. Along with the bar on the first level there is a beautiful seating area, with hammocks and tables, next to our private waterfall. If no guests are staying in our other rentals or if you are part of the group booking, you have access to either our private infinity pool that has great ocean views or the swimming pool at the lower house. The outdoor staircase leading from the infinity pool down to the Honeymoon Suite is picturesque - great for weddings or Instagram moments. We also have a large event pavilion that is open to all guests. If you are planning an event you can request private access. The event space can accommodate 100 people and is complete with lounge chairs, couches and hammocks. If it is not being used for an event, it is a great place to hang out and read a book.You will be only a three minute walk to one of the best beaches in Rincon, Sandy Beach, and the famous seaside restaurant Tamboo Bar & Grill. You can sit on the beach and have your food or drinks delivered right to your chair! We have beach chairs available for your use.You are also within walking distance to several other restaurants, bars and small grocery store. If you are thinking of a destination wedding or a special event please let us know!Guest accessYou have access to all of the common area. We have a shower at the bottom of the steps to use when coming back from the beach.Other things to noteEarly Check-in: If you are arriving on a flight overnight and require early-check in we can provide this to you for $100 This option depends on availability! We will meet you at the house upon arrival to give you the keys. We have been traveling to Rincon since 1994 and lived here since 2007. We would love to give you recommendations to all the great places in the area, just ask!

Reservations are confirmed in acknowledgement that the interruption of these services caused by the provider will not result in the termination of the reservation or any type of refunds.Other this to note:We spray for bugs with a professional on a regularly basis but please have in mind that the suite is in a forest area and the space is created in a inside/outside space which still might have bugs in a natural forest setting.Important: RESERVATIONS IN JUNE IN PUERTO RICO THERES A NATURAL PHENOMENON. We left all the lights off because the first couple of hard rains in May and June every year makes termites in the trees hatch, these fly all over the island and are attracted by light. It's very difficult to predict when they are going to hatch. The first couple of hard rains in May every year makes termites in the trees hatch, these fly all over the island and are attracted by light. It's very difficult to predict when they are going to hatch. THIS HAPPENS EVERYWHERE IN PUERTO RICO, you can be in a restaurant, the airbnb or any place in the island.There’s no way to exterminate them as they are in almost every three in Puerto Rico and attracted by light. They are harmless but a pain to clean.They fly during the night of a very hard rain, it is VERY IMPORTANT that you leave all the LIGHTS OFF inside the apartment when you leave or while you are in there because these flying termites will come in. It's very hard to predict the date but I know it's around this time of the year.Please TURN OFF ALL the light when expected to come back at night or when leaving at night or if you are in the apartment and see flying bugs do so as well.
